data.rationale:
## Decision
Use the existing PRISM-Causal module (cortical/reasoning/prism_causal.py) as the
foundation for GoT causal analysis rather than building a separate system.

## Alternatives Considered
1. Build separate causal analysis from scratch
2. Use external library (e.g., DoWhy, CausalNex)
3. Integrate PRISM-Causal (CHOSEN)

## Rationale
- PRISM-Causal already implements do-calculus, counterfactuals, necessity/sufficiency
- Follows Sovereignty Principle - we own the code
- Enables future integration with PLN probabilistic reasoning
- Behavioral tests already validate the causal semantics

## Trade-offs
- Requires mapping GoT edge types to causal semantics
- Data quality in GoT affects analysis reliability
- Need SOPs to ensure consistent data collection

## Files Affected
- cortical/got/causal_analysis.py (new)
- cortical/got/cli/causal.py (new)
- CLAUDE.md (SOPs added)
- tests/behavioral/test_got_causal_integration.py (created)
data.title: Integrate PRISM-Causal with GoT for causal analysis
